Good Game But Very Short Could Have Been Made To Be Much Larger. 
Easy 8 out of 10.

Pros: 
- Good Graphics
- Good Story Line Single Player or Multiplayer
- Quality Voice Acting
- Very Well Made Guns Handling, Movement, Enemies Movement. 0 Glitches For Me
- Nice Old School Alien Nostalgia With Semi Unexpected Twist Ending
- Bought it on sale for something like 80% very good value for the amount spent would of paid the regular price if the game was 40+ hours instead of 15. But I assume its a very niche game for people who liked the old alien movies so maybe the money wasn't there for the producers

Cons:
- 90% of my cons was this was WAY TOO SHORT maybe 15 to 20 hours of game play on normal difficulty including the even shorter extended contagion dlc
- Story leaves way more questions than answers
- Game has wave clear missions but for me didn't extend the shelf life. I tried one and got no rewards for it should at least get a little bit of credits or xp for the attempts considering the rest of the game is so short. 
- There's many guns you basically can't afford on the first play through which is a shame unless you plan on playing campaign more than one time. (you should make the guns cheaper and add most of the decorative content for free with purchase or unlockable much faster in game)
- Very small but when talking to people in the dialogue their lips don't move thought this was weird considering the graphics and the voice actors were good.

This is a really solid game. The Aliens fan service is spot on, though in some cases they follow the inspiration a little too closely. There is some neat variation in enemy types, though the levels tend to be fairly similar. But, the guns feel great, the visuals are great, and there is some nice progression. Ultimately, I feel a little bad for this game. In a world where Helldivers 2 exists, this game just feels a bit small and focused. It works pretty well in single player, but will always  be more fun with friends. I played a few games with randos that worked, but there aren't a ton of folks playing. If you have two buddies and grab it on sale, I say do it for a break from other stuff. Plays well on the Steam Deck.
